description: This line plot illustrates the relative change in performance metrics across different layers of a model, comparing various token-precision configurations for KV cache compression. The x-axis represents model layers, divided into five segments: Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32, with a linear scale. The y-axis represents Relative Change in percentage, ranging from -25% to 5%, also on a linear scale. Five distinct lines are plotted: a yellow line with circle markers representing LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit; a red line with square markers for LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit; a cyan line with circle markers for RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit; a blue line with square markers for RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit; and a gray dashed line for the Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit. The baseline remains nearly flat at 0% across all layers. The yellow line starts near 0%, dips slightly, and then rises slightly. The red line starts near 0%, dips to approximately -5% at Layer5-12, then rises to approximately 0% at Layer21-28, and ends near 0%. The cyan line starts near 0%, dips to approximately -15% at Layer13-20, then rises to approximately 0% at Layer21-28, and ends near 0%. The blue line starts near -5%, dips sharply to approximately -25% at Layer13-20, then rises to approximately -5% at Layer21-28, and ends near -5%.
